system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: We pair it with generalizable prompt templates for each specialist agent, filling only the input for each of the 99 test cases.
system_prompt_style.note: Only the paper describes prompts; the prompt-building code was not in the evidence.

env_context_strategy.note: Source files (main.py, tool_schemas.py) not included in the evidence; the specialists use screenshots and setup tools.

context_compaction.note: Loop code (operate.py) not in the evidence.

observation_format.evidence_quote: Whenever the screen changes,SpecOpscaptures the runtime display, which is then for-warded as key evidence for potential bugs.
observation_format.note: Tool outputs are also text (paper Sec. 4.3, tool call outputs). This is inferred from the paper.

tool_call_format.note: Bedrock Converse tool definitions imply native tool calling. operate.py also does JSON extraction; the paper says MCP.

tool_count.note: tool_schemas.py content not in the evidence.

edit_primitive.note: The tool registry was not available in the evidence.

tool_schema_source.note: A dedicated schema file suggests hand-written schemas, but the file was not opened.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: We implement specialized versions of these as MCP tools for the Engineer specialist.
protocol_standardization.note: Paper claim. The repo README lists Bedrock tool schemas and no MCP client was seen.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: SpecOps decomposes testing into four specialized phases, each handled by distinct LLM-based specialist agents
loop_primitives.note: There is a four-phase pipeline. Within phases a tool loop runs (operate.py). The Architect/Analyst review is the generate-and-repair element.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: produce a bundled test spec-ification that ensures coherence across environment setup, test prompts, and validation oracles. This specification is updated dur-ing execution
planning_granularity.note: The test case JSON is written to outputs and re-read by later phases.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: Each phase is handled by aspecialist: an autonomous agent whose tools, heuristics, and objectives are tuned exclusively to that phase.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Each subsequent phase references this evolving specification, maintaining consistency throughout the pipeline.
delegation_mechanism.note: Closest value: hand-off happens via a shared spec across phase specialists, not via spawning.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: producing a bug report with no human in the loop

short_term_state.note: The structured test case JSON carries state across phases.

long_term_memory.note: Source code not in the evidence.

state_persistence.note: main.py loop not in the evidence. The --phase flag allows per-phase runs; resume semantics are unknown.

self_verification.evidence_quote: the *Test Analyst* reviews them for feasibility, prompt completeness, and oracle generalizability
self_verification.note: The Judge specialist evaluates the subject agent. The Analyst reviews the Architect's output.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: the Infrastructure Manager read the error in API call responses, retried, and after the set number of retries, abandoned execution
retry_policy.note: These are setup-phase retries, not whole-task retries.

rollback.note: The spec has cleanup instructions between tests, but no rollback code was in the evidence.

termination_condition.note: Run loop (operate.py) not in the evidence.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: the subject agent installed and running on the same machine
execution_isolation.note: GUI actions run via pyautogui directly on the host desktop.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: For file system testing, we operate as a non-root user, restricted to the/home/user directory.
filesystem_access.note: The paper describes the host as non-root. This is relative to the host.

network_policy.note: Real Gmail access is required; no network configuration was seen.

tracing.evidence_quote: The `examples/` directory contains annotated end-to-end runs with test specifications, execution logs, and screenshots.
tracing.note: The run logs may be unstructured (run_log.log). A screen recorder also exists.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: producing a bug report with no human in the loop
eval_hooks.note: The system is itself a testing framework. No benchmark evaluation runner is in the file tree.

target_domain.evidence_quote: Fully automated testing framework for GUI-based AI agents in real-world environments.
target_domain.note: The domain is agent testing (other) via GUI computer use.
